gpu_tip: ~259GB total at 128K context — the full-precision build, far past any consumer machine even though only 5.1B of its 124B parameters run per token. A 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4080) keeps the attention and shared-expert layers at full speed while llama.cpp's expert offloading spills the routed experts to a workstation with ~384GB of system RAM.
mac_tip: Too big for any MacBook Pro (128GB max) — needs a 512GB Mac Studio (M3 Ultra).
